scenarios.task: Replace corroded conduit and rewire pump controls for a floodgate on the River Cherwell towpath.
steps: Lock out and tag out the pump panel
Verify zero energy with a meter at the disconnect
Drain and ventilate the gate pit before entry
Remove corroded conduit and pull new THHN through PVC-coated raceway
Torque lugs to spec and megger the new runs
Restore power, test gate travel, complete permit closeout

rubric.pass_if: Applies lock, tag and verifies zero energy before touching conductors
Uses rated fittings and supports conduit per code for wet locations
Attendant and permit in place before pit entry
Insulation resistance test passes before re-energizing

scenarios.robot_role: Tows materials along the flooded towpath and carries a camera for the attendant's pre-entry pit inspection.

scenarios.task: Repair timber piles and decking on the boardwalk crossing Christ Church Meadow's wet ground.
steps: Survey the walk for soft decking and mark hazards
Set up exclusion zone around the works
Jack and brace the sagging bay before cutting out rotten piles
Fit treated replacement piles and fix with galvanized hardware
Re-nail or screw decking, checking for proud fasteners
Housekeep and clear the path for pedestrians

rubric.pass_if: Braces the bay before cutting so decking cannot drop
Lifts beams with a partner or mechanical aid, back straight
Uses corrosion-resistant fixings suitable for wet timber
Barriers and signage separate work from towpath users

scenarios.task: Inspect, tag and correct a tube-and-clamp scaffold against a college quad wall before masons lift stone.
ppe: safety harness for full height check
steps: Check base plates and sole boards on the cobbles
Verify standards plumb and all couplers tight
Confirm guardrails, toe boards and brick guards on all lifts
Check tie schedule against the wall anchors
Attach green Scafftag and record inspection
Report defects and barricade below before stone lift

rubric.pass_if: Confirms full bearing on sole boards over cobblestones
Ties match the design schedule for wall type
Scafftag signed and dated before use
Sets and enforces a drop zone below the lift

scenarios.robot_role: Carries a lidar payload to scan the scaffold from the ground, flagging plumb deviation and missing guardrails for the crew.

scenarios.task: Isolate a steam line and replace a failed trap in an old library boilerhouse.
steps: Obtain hot-work permit and line isolation plan
Isolate, lock out and bleed the segment to zero pressure
Treat existing lagging as presumed asbestos; do not disturb
Break flanges with body positioned out of the steam path
Swap trap, renew gasket, torque bolts evenly
Re-energize slowly and verify trap operation

rubric.pass_if: Bleeds to zero and locks out both sides before breaking flange
Stops work and reports rather than cutting lagging
Stands clear of flange gap when cracking the joint
Opens valve gradually to avoid water hammer

scenarios.task: Repair lead flashing on a steep slate roof of a dining hall, rigged with edge protection.
steps: Complete a rescue plan and pre-use check harness and anchor lines
Fix scaffold edge protection and roofing ladder runners
Strip failed flashing without breaking slates
Dress and weld new lead with the gas kit, guarding flame
Secure lead soars and dress joints with tampers
Remove all tools by hoist bag and clear gutters

rubric.pass_if: 100% tie-off from ladder to roof work
Walks on ladders or bearers, never directly on slate
Welds pass visual check with no burn-through
No loose tools left at edge; bagged hoist used

scenarios.robot_role: Ferries small lead offcuts and tools up the stair access, keeping hands free on ladders.

scenarios.task: Retrofit reading-room luminaires to LED with switching upgrades, working around occupied library hours.
steps: Survey existing circuits and confirm isolation points per room
Notify occupants and cordon the bay being retrofitted
De-energize, verify dead, and cap old feeds
Swap luminaires and drivers, dressing new flex in existing trunking
Test lux levels and emergency lighting at the stair
Clean up dust with HEPA vacuum only

rubric.pass_if: Each circuit verified dead at point of work before disconnecting
Cordons and signs prevent reader access below lifts
Uses HEPA vacuum and avoids dry sweeping ceiling debris
Emergency lights pass discharge test

scenarios.task: Rake out and repoint decayed limestone joints on a hall elevation from a mast climber.
hazards: uneven ground loading for mast base
steps: Set mast climper base on rated cribbing, level and tied
Fit dust extraction to raking tools before starting
Rake joints to sound mortar depth only, keeping joints wet-swept
Mix lime mortar to match the existing joint profile
Firm, strike and brush joints in sequence with the weather
Protect fresh work from frost and rain before demobilizing

rubric.pass_if: On-tool extraction or water suppression in use at all times
Platform load limits respected and gates closed
Lime mix and joint profile match original elevation
Covers new joints against frost or rain

scenarios.robot_role: Under supervision, runs a raking head with extraction on straight lifts, keeping the apprentice clear of vibration and dust.

scenarios.task: Rig and signal the replacement of a rooftop chiller over a occupied courtyard with a mobile crane.
steps: Attend lift plan briefing and confirm exclusion zone with college
Inspect slings, shackles and spreader beam; check tags
Rig chiller to plan, attach tag lines before lift
Run trial lift a few inches and check balance
Direct crane with standard hand signals through the courtyard gap
Land on roof skids, dog off, then derig under supervision

rubric.pass_if: Rejects any untagged or damaged gear before use
Courtyard cleared and barriers manned for the full lift
Single signaller using standard signals, crane pauses on any confusion
Tag lines attached and controlled to prevent spin
